description: Primary Card Number is required when Liability Indicator is 003
Amount of installment required for all facilities except 002, 003, 004
Highest credit amount should be null for any other facility than 002, 003, 004
Highest credit amount should not be null for facilities 002, 003, 004
For facilities other than revolving facilities (002, 003, 004) the term of loan is required
If Number of days past due is greater than 0 then Amount Overdue cannot be zero
If Amount Overdue is greater than zero, Last Payment Date cannot be null
If Account status is 005 'Written Off' then Credit Facility Write-Off Date cannot be null
If Account status is 005 'Written Off' then Amount Written Off should be greater than zero
If Account status is 003 'Closed' then Account Closed Date should be not null
If Account status is not 005 'Written Off' then Amount Written Off should be zero or null
If Credit facility is other than 002,0003,004 then Number of Installment should be greater than zero
